_comment: Single source for every manifest. Edit this, then run scripts/gen_manifests.py. The generated files are checked in so installs need no build step, and scripts/tests/test_manifests.py fails if they drift from this file.

shared.name: trellis
shared.description: Local kanban boards and vaults for AI agents: board state at session start, cards with expiring claims, and a linked markdown vault.

marketplace.description: Local kanban boards and vaults for AI agents. SessionStart hook injects board state and a command cheatsheet. The skills cover claiming work, recording progress, and when to write an entry.
marketplace.pluginDescription: Work with trellis board state, cards, and vault entries. SessionStart hook for adoption.

interface.shortDescription: Local kanban boards and vaults for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Trellis gives AI coding agents a local kanban board and a linked markdown vault. Use it to claim work safely, record progress, preserve what it learns, and recover context across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Show my Trellis work and blockers.
Claim the next available Trellis card.
Save what this session verified in Trellis.
